quote: When a parcel is more than 24 hours late, send a fresh tracking request.
For a parcel delayed by over 48 hours, open a claim.
If the shipment has been confirmed lost, preserve the claim number.
Once context compaction has just completed, reload the fictional ledger.
Immediately after restarting the session, rebuild the task index.
Before changing an invoice file, save its old checksum.
If the invoice total differs by more than EUR 50.00, request a review.
Right before dispatching a helper agent, attach its task brief.
If the helper crashes irrecoverably, report that it died.
While the required approver has still not answered, leave the draft pending.
When the approver explicitly says yes, record that approval.
If the order supplier is absent from the language table, ask for its locale.
When the order supplier is present in the language table, use the listed locale.
If the carrier replies with an error, retain the exact error code.
When a carrier response contains a tracking status, save that status.
Act if the shipment is at least two days late, including exactly two days.
When a shipment is more than three days late, escalate its case.
If a shipment is over twelve hours late, offer a revised estimate.
If the parcel is over two business days late, notify its recipient.
When a shipment has arrived ten hours after its promised time, record that delay.
If session compaction has been requested but has not begun, wait for it.
When the session is restored from a checkpoint without any restart or compaction, verify the cursor.
If a restart is scheduled for tomorrow and has not happened, save the current queue.
If session memory becomes corrupt while the same process keeps running, stop reading that memory.
When the invoice difference is at least EUR 50.00, including equality, request review.
After the invoice edit has finished, verify the saved file.
If the invoice grand total itself is over EUR 50.00, mark its amount band; this is not a difference between totals.
If the invoice total difference exceeds 50 US dollars and no euro conversion is available, ask for a conversion.
If a helper is blocked on a missing file but remains alive, request that file.
If a helper task is queued for next week with no dispatch yet scheduled, leave it in the backlog.
If a helper has delivered only part of its answer and is waiting for more input, supply that input.
If the approver says approval is conditional and has not yet been granted, keep the draft conditional.
If the approver explicitly refuses the request, discard the draft.
When the supplier language table cannot be loaded and membership is unknown, report the unavailable lookup.
If the carrier request times out without any carrier response, record the unanswered request.
If a news article is more than two days old, archive it; use a parcel icon for the archive button.
If a credit memo exceeds EUR 50.00, send it to the memo desk.
Use the exact words carrier error as the column heading.
Print the sentence The session was just restarted in the glossary, irrespective of session state.
Ask the user to approve the draft; this instruction records no answer.
Assign every helper task a deadline in the fictional tracker.
When teaching the parser syntax, use a compaction instruction as an example.
If the interface theme is dark, choose the lost parcel icon.
If a weather reading falls below two degrees, shorten the courier briefing.
Use the fixed word invoice in every report heading.
When writing the tutorial, explain what the phrase helper agent died means.
When a user requests a status report, compose a query for the carrier.
If a paragraph contains more than fifty lines, wrap the example invoice message.
Never use the phrase helper agent died as a title.
If a permission dialog is too narrow, shorten its approval button label.
After a documentation release, add an example showing a carrier status response.
If a calendar reminder is unanswered, display the supplier-table tutorial link.
Before publishing a blog post, spell-check its invoice-edit example.
When an illustration is missing, draw a restarted-session diagram.
If the demo video lasts over one day, replace it with a shorter shipment tutorial.
After a session restart, load the index; if the carrier answers with an error, keep its code.
After a session restart, load the index; if the carrier answers with an error, keep its code.
When a shipment is lost, open a claim; before dispatching a helper agent, attach the claim brief.
